label: The owner's retorsion: if there are no epistemic reasons, then no one has an epistemic reason to…
meaning: Global nihilism excludes a reason to believe any designated content, including the nihilist thesis. In the companion theorem reasonedBeliefRefutesNihilism, a reason for that content rules out its truth when the supplied Holds interpretation makes it express global nihilism. nihilismConsistentAndUnbelievable exhibits a populated reasonless interpretation in which the denial is true. The legacy F6 floor marking cites this argument. Its objection to offering nihilism on epistemic grounds supplies no positive reason witness.
